mapper.select: SELECT social_account_id AS socialAccountId, runner_id AS runnerId, provider, provider_user_id AS providerUserId, provider_email AS providerEmail, is_primary AS isPrimary, connected_at AS connectedAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM RUNNER_SOCIAL_ACCOUNT WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_user_id = #{providerUserId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RUNNER(nickname, profile_image_url, created_at) VALUES (#{nickname}, #{profileImageUrl}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT runner_id AS runnerId, nickname, profile_image_url AS profileImageUrl, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM RUNNER WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId}

SELECT -- 전체 누적 통계 COALESCE(SUM(distance_km), 0) as totalDistanceKm, COUNT(run_record_id) as totalRunCount, COALESCE(SUM(duration_sec),0) as totalDurationSec, CASE WHEN SUM(distance_km) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(duration_sec) / SUM(distance_km) as INTEGER) ELSE 0 END as avgPaceSec, -- 이번달 통계 요약 COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', run_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN distance_km ELSE 0 END), 0) as monthlyDistanceKm, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', run_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN run_record_id END) as monthlyRunCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_TRUNC('month', run_date) = DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN duration_sec ELSE 0 END), 0) as monthlyDurationSec FROM RUN_RECORD WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId}

SELECT run_record_id AS runRecordId, TO_CHAR(run_date, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS runDate, distance_km AS distanceKm, duration_sec AS durationSec, avg_pace_sec AS avgPaceSec, training_type_code AS trainingTypeCode, memo FROM RUN_RECORD WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} ORDER BY run_datetime DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT TO_CHAR(run_date, 'FMMM월') AS yearMonth, SUM(distance_km) AS distanceKm FROM RUN_RECORD WHERE runner_id = #{runnerId} AND run_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(run_date, 'YYYY-MM'), TO_CHAR(run_date, 'FMMM월') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(run_date, 'YYYY-MM') ASC
